<TEI xmlns='http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0'><seg xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" type="excerpt" xml:id="ex8001_2024-11-1408-36-05" status="finalized"><milestone n="Lineage of the Abhidharmasamuccaya" unit="section"/>
				<l><rs type="deity">byams pa</rs>s <rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:3756">thogs myed</rs> la bshad |</l> 
				<l>des <rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:3758">dbyig <lb n="10b9"/> gnyen</rs> la bshad | </l>
				<l>des <rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:6262">blo brtan</rs> la bshad | </l>
				<l><rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:6975">pan pyi ta gang pa spel</rs> la bshad | </l>
				<l><choice><sic>(d)ed</sic><corr>des</corr></choice> <rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:6667">kha che 'dzi na mi tra</rs> la bshad | </l>
				<l>des <rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:4222">ska ba dpal rtsegs</rs> | <rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:4226">cog ro klu'i rgyal mtshan</rs> | <rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:4227">sna nam ye shes</rs> ste gsum la bshad |</l> 
				<l>de gsum gyis <rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:4229">sbas rgyal ba'i ye shes</rs> la bshad | </l>
				<l>des <rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:4230">gru rgyal ba'i ye shes</rs> la bshad | </l>
				<l>des <rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:4231">gru mchog gyi ye shes</rs> la bshad | </l>
				<l>des <rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:4232">se btsun gzhon nu</rs> la bshad | </l>
				<l>des <rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:4234">'gar mi yon tan <pb n="11a"/><lb n="11a1"/> g.yung drung</rs> la bshad | </l>
				<l>des <rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:4235">khu ston brtson 'grus g.yung drung</rs> la bshad |</l> 
				
				<l>des <rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:4237">ra</rs> <rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:4238">rgya</rs> la bshad |</l>

				<l>de dag gis <rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:4291">brang</rs> <rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:4241">ko</rs> la bshad de |</l>
				de ltar mngon pa'i sems tsam gyi bdam ngag rgyud ma chad pa yin no || |</seg></TEI>
